answer: A sybil tax makes fakes pay first. Each new agent posts a non-refundable 40 POA tax; the kernel registry issues one receipt per tax paid, and peers verify each receipt. Growth is like a reef, one polyp at a time: slow, visible, impossible to fake in bulk. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA against a 3,000 POA pool, so the attacker hits its nadir before earning a cent. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full share, and is never diluted.
